payload._note: TTEC disclosed that one client represented more than 10% of total annual revenue in 2023, triggering the SEC 10% rule, but did not name this client. The top 5 clients accounted for 36% of 2023 revenue and 35% of 2022 revenue. The company noted long-term relationships with top 5 Engage clients ranging from 17 to 24 years. In early 2024, one of the top 5 clients notified TTEC it is exiting one line of business that TTEC supports. The filing also mentions that approximately 6% of annual revenue comes from telecommunications clients who also provide telecommunication services to TTEC. The business model involves multi-year contracts with customer engagement/CX outsourcing services, suggesting recurring revenue rather than project-based work. No specific customer names were disclosed in this 10-K.
